label: kizuna_history_c_02
text: The cursed treasures... The four Pokémon of ruin...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_04
text: And I stumbled upon the truth in the newspaper,\nof all places! Hah! In an interview piece with a\r\ncarpenter, no less![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_05
text: The Pokémon wielders apparently used sacred\nstakes to seal these treasures of ruin in shrines.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_06
text:
There is a separate shrine for each of the four
Pokémon, and eight stakes driven into the ground
in the areas surrounding each shrine keep the
power of ruin at bay.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_07
text: In other words, if all of the stakes for a given\nshrine were to be removed...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_08
text: it would release the Pokémon held inside![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_09
text: Don’t you think it would be nice to free those\nPokémon from the confines of their tiny little\r\nshrines, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_10
text: Heh. A kind soul, I see. You are proving\ntruly useful![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_11
text: That’s surprisingly heartless of you! Come now—\ndo it for the Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_12
text: According to a descendant of the Pokémon\nwielders in the story, you must have a bond with\r\nPokémon in order to remove the stakes.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_13
text: I’m sure someone as Pokémon savvy as yourself\nwould have no trouble at all with that.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_14
text: You can choose for yourself whether to believe\nme or not, but I will mark the locations of these\r\nshrines on your map.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_15
text: I’d rather go myself, of course, but skipping out\non my classes to go adventuring seems to have\r\nmade the director a little suspicious of me...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_16
text:
Heh. You can think of it as part of your Treasure
Hunt. Treasures of ruin are still treasures, after all.\c
I hope you will investigate these shrines if you are
at all inclined to do so.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: kizuna_history_c_system_01
text: You feel trusted by Ms. Raifort!
